newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH GOVT TO PRIVATISE JAN BECHER LIQUOR FIRM.
newsitem.headline: CZECH GOVT TO PRIVATISE JAN BECHER LIQUOR FIRM.

text.p: The Czech government's privatisation commission decided on Tuesday to sell off a state held 94 percent stake in liquor maker Jan Becher-Karlovarska Becherovka a.s.> through a public tender, a cabinet aide said.

Michaela Erbenova, an economic adviser to Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus, told reporters at a briefing that a 30 percent stake would be sold in the first stage along with a three-year option for the rest.
"Privatisation will be done in the form of a tender announced by the Finance Ministry," Erbenova said.
She added that the new owner would receive rights to 21 percent of the remaining government shares in order to provide the investor with an operating majority in the company.
Erbenova said the tender would only be open to entities registered in the Czech Republic.
Jan Becher, established in 1807, makes a popular sweet herb liquor "Becherovka" in the western spa town of Karlovy Vary.
